name: calculate-section-12b-solar-deduction
description: Calculate the South African Section 12B renewable-energy (solar PV) tax deduction and real cash saving for a business taxpayer.
requires_human_steps: Obtain a valid Certificate of Compliance (CoC) from a registered electrician
Itemise equipment separately from labour on the supplier invoice
Confirm commissioning date falls in the intended tax year
Have a registered tax practitioner confirm the claim before filing
rule_basis: Income Tax Act s12B (live, permanent); s12BA (expired 28 Feb 2025)
